protocol.expected_outcome_if_the_evidence_says_so: NO_ECONOMIC_EDGE_FOUND, with the research lane kept and the next hypothesis named

families.hypothesis: H: a close above the 168h high is informative only when realised volatility is in its upper-middle range — dead markets produce false breakouts and panic regimes produce reversals — so the Donchian entry is gated on the ATR percentile and on price being above the long trend.
families.name: vol_regime_breakout

families.hypothesis: H: in an established uptrend, a first close back below a fast mean is a continuation entry rather than a reversal, provided the trend filter and the recovery above the fast mean are both required before entry.
families.name: trend_pullback

families.hypothesis: H: the relative ordering of 72h returns across a fixed liquid universe carries information that a single-asset trend rule cannot see, so holding the top-k names while the absolute trend filter is up beats holding any one of them.
families.name: cross_sectional_rotation

families.hypothesis: H: a two-sigma stretch below a 48h mean reverts only when volatility is low and the bar is liquid; without those two conditions the same stretch is the start of a trend and the strategy is on the wrong side of it.
families.name: mean_reversion_vol_liq

families.hypothesis: H: a passive order inside the spread can be filled favourably often enough to beat the taker round trip. It is listed because the brief asks for it and it is NOT tested, because measuring it needs a fill model this repository does not have.
families.name: maker_only_spread_capture
families.required_evidence: a recorded order-book or trade-print source at sub-second resolution plus a queue model validated against real fills; then, and only then, a maker backtest
families.untestable_reason: no verifiable queue-position or fill-probability model exists in the tree, and without one a maker backtest reports fills it could not have obtained

protocol.selection_rule: parameters are fixed here and are not searched on the evaluation segment; a family is ADOPTed only if it clears every threshold on data it did not select on, and this project has no such data until the prospective slice accrues
